lines: Why fewer than 100 people remember every day.
Testers match dates to 60 famous events.
Each answer must come within 11 seconds.
After a 2006 study, over 200 people claimed it.
Only a handful turned out to be genuine.
It covers personal life events, not everything they read.
So forgetting may be as useful as remembering.
